verdict: Client could not connect to the WSUS server. Server may be down, the WsusPool app pool may be recycling, or network/firewall is blocking the port.
fix: On the SUP server, verify IIS is running and `WsusPool` is started (it stops on memory-limit hits; raise `Private Memory Limit` to 0 to disable the cap). From the client, run `Test-NetConnection <sup-fqdn> -Port 8530` (or 8531 for HTTPS). If the pool is healthy but the client still fails, capture ETL or Fiddler to see the actual HTTP response.
